🇮🇷 Iran's Leader signals missile range far beyond the old 2,000 km cap The media office of Iran's Leader has posted a ballistic missile on its launcher at the centre of range rings marked from 500 km to 5,000 km. The 4,500 km and 5,000 km rings glow red.… 🇮🇷 BREAKING! It's official: Iran's missiles have no range limit anymore Asked about Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei's order for a response "without geographical limits," IRGC spokesman Sardar Mohebbi confirmed that Iran's 2,000 km missile range cap is gone. That limit had been set by the late Supreme Leader, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, he said, and with the new order, Iran can also target US bases in Europe. Iran has already demonstrated a range of 4,500 km, Mohebbi added, by targeting the US base on Diego Garcia in the Indian Ocean. 🔴 @DDGeopolitics
